clue.text: Swindle as rascal, extracting last penny

indicators.note: extracting the last letter means the closing letter of the rascal word is pulled out

parts.note: a scamp is a mischievous rascal
P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: A con trick is described as the sort of thing a rascal would pull, minus the small change.
explanation.definitionFit: A scam is a dishonest scheme to cheat someone, a direct synonym for a swindle.

clue.text: 20% of large delivery to church is fruit

parts.note: a delivery of quintuplets is five babies, so one fifth of it is one quin
CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: A clergyman receives a share of a big shipment of produce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Large delivery' here means a birth of quintuplets; 20% of five babies is one, a quin.
explanation.definitionFit: The quince is a hard yellow pear-shaped fruit used for jelly and preserves.

clue.text: Number present hours before midnight take steps

parts.note: at ten in the evening is two hours before midnight
to dance is to take steps to music

explanation.surface: Someone counting heads at an evening event before stepping out.
explanation.definitionFit: Attendance is the count of people who turn up, the number present at an event.

clue.text: Person who forms original phrase

indicators.note: original in the sense of inventive or freshly made, so the word phrase is newly arranged

explanation.surface: A description of someone who coins a fresh expression.
explanation.definitionFit: One who shapes things gives them form, so a shaper is a person who forms.

clue.text: Dose of liquid medicine quickly containing onset of pretty bad flu

indicators.note: containing means the word for quickly holds the next letter within it

parts.note: soon means before long, quickly

indicators.note: onset of means the beginning letter of the word pretty
bad signals the letters of flu are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone with a nasty bout of flu wants their medicine fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' looks like it describes the illness, but it is the signal to rearrange the three letters after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid medicine is measured out by the spoon, so a spoonful is a standard dose.

clue.text: Fellow and I have hit, fame and some money

parts.note: I've is the contraction of I have
to pound is to hit hard
note means renown, as in a person of note

explanation.surface: A man boasts of a hit record, celebrity and a bit of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A banknote worth five pounds sterling is a specific sum of cash, so it is some money.

clue.text: Power cuts, say, agitated queen, for example

parts.note: P is the symbol for power in physics

indicators.note: agitated means stirred up, so the letters of cuts and say are mixed together

explanation.surface: Electricity outages prompt a monarch to get rattled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'queen' is not royalty: a queen is a female cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A female cat is called a queen, so a queen is one example of a pet cat.

clue.text: King Edward

definitions.meaning: the title monarch of Shakespeare's tragedy
the Victorian nonsense poet who wrote The Owl and the Pussy-cat

explanation.surface: A name that reads as one English monarch, or a potato variety.
explanation.walkthrough: King Edward is also a British potato variety, but the two words define separately.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragic king and the nonsense poet Edward share this surname.

clue.text: Romantic activity in vessel — after love, in short

indicators.note: after places the boat word behind the wooing word

parts.note: to court is, in a word, to woo or make love to someone
a ship is a seagoing vessel

explanation.surface: A romance aboard a boat, summed up briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in short' tells you to compress the idea of making love into one brief verb, COURT.
explanation.definitionFit: Wooing someone with a view to marriage is courtship, the classic romantic pursuit.

clue.text: Toughen up concerning cut by university

indicators.note: cut by means the concerning phrase is split open with the next letter inserted

parts.note: in re is Latin for in the matter of, concerning

explanation.surface: A university course trimmed to make students hardier.
explanation.definitionFit: To inure is to harden someone to hardship, accustoming them until they become tough.

clue.text: Setter's devouring cold chop

indicators.note: devouring means the possessive word swallows the next letter

parts.note: the setter refers to himself, so setter's means mine
C stands for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: The compiler is tucking into a cold meat chop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chop' looks like a noun for meat but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To mince is to chop food very finely, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Person in chair varying poses for painter, ultimately

indicators.note: varying means the letters of poses for are changed into a different order
ultimately means the final letter of the word painter

explanation.surface: A sitter strikes a series of poses for an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chair' is an academic chair, not furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A university professor holds a chair, the senior post in a subject.

clue.text: Advocate adding page in front of article

indicators.note: in front of puts the page letter before the newspaper word

parts.note: a leader is a newspaper's leading article or editorial

explanation.surface: An editor adds a page ahead of a newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleader argues a case in court, so is an advocate.

clue.text: See 6
Third withdrawn from funds for men committed to partnerships

indicators.note: the third letter is withdrawn, taken out of the word for funds

parts.note: finances are funds or money resources

explanation.surface: A third of the money taken out of the account of some engaged couples.
explanation.definitionFit: Engaged men have pledged themselves to marriage, a committed partnership to come.

clue.text: Monroe's art excited one looking up to stars

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters of Monroe's art are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Marilyn Monroe's acting thrills a devoted fan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looking up to stars' reads like idolising film stars, but means gazing at the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A scientist who studies celestial bodies literally looks up at the stars.

clue.text: Dish eaten with spoon, darling

definitions.meaning: a pudding or dessert, eaten with a spoon
a term of endearment, like sweetheart

explanation.surface: Someone addressing a loved one over dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a pudding course is called a sweet, and sweet is also an endearment for a loved one.

clue.text: Release princess initially trapped in loveless marriage

indicators.note: trapped in means the opening letter is shut inside the marriage word
loveless means the letter standing for love, zero, is dropped

parts.note: a union is a marriage

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of princess

explanation.surface: A princess stuck in a cold marriage wants to be set free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loveless' drops O (love, a zero score) from UNION to leave UNIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To unpin something is to release it by taking out the pins that fix it.

clue.text: Like vegetable or fruit, not quite raw

indicators.note: not quite means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a pear is a fruit
green means raw or unripe

explanation.surface: A comparison of produce, half-ripe or uncooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Pea green is the bright colour of peas, so something that colour looks like the vegetable.

clue.text: Start from birds in general, one in particular

indicators.note: start from means the first letter is taken from the general word for birds

parts.note: fowl is a collective word for birds generally

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher moving from the general to the specific.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking one in particular to mean one particular bird, an owl is a single species of bird.

clue.text: Excel as runner, not in football gear

parts.note: out is the opposite of in
a team's strip is its football kit

explanation.surface: An athlete shines once out of their football kit.
explanation.walkthrough: STRIP is British for a sports team's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: To outstrip someone is to outrun them, so to excel in a race.

clue.text: Right for which Muhammad Ali often fought

definitions.text: for which Muhammad Ali often fought
definitions.meaning: a boxing championship, the heavyweight crown

explanation.surface: A claim the boxing champion kept defending.
explanation.definitionFit: Title is both a legal right to property and a sporting championship such as a boxing belt.

clue.text: Requiring maximum amount of cash, honey

definitions.meaning: the most expensive, costing the most

explanation.surface: Someone telling a sweetheart that the priciest option is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear means costly, so the superlative is the most costly; it is also an endearment for a loved one.

clue.text: Did brain operation, albeit with limited time

parts.note: albeit means though

indicators.note: limited means the word time is cut down to its opening letter

explanation.surface: A surgeon operated on a brain despite being short of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brain operation' is not surgery but simply using one's brain.
explanation.definitionFit: Using the brain to reason is to think, so the past tense means did brain work.

clue.text: Land in Asia, mainly, as occasional flier

definitions.meaning: a country lying mostly in Asia, with a small part in Europe
a farmyard bird that rarely takes to the air

explanation.surface: A traveller who flies now and then lands mostly in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The country lies chiefly in Asia Minor, and the bird of the same name can fly only in short bursts.

clue.text: What's instrumental in 9? Half of this publication's about it

indicators.note: about means the half-name goes around the word it
half of means the first four of the paper's eight letters

parts.note: the clue appears in the Guardian newspaper

explanation.surface: A puzzle asks what plays a part in wooing, citing its own paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this publication' is the Guardian, the newspaper where the puzzle ran; 9 refers back to the clue at 9 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A serenading lover strums this instrument, so it is literally instrumental in wooing.

clue.text: Indicator of change, sign mostly displayed in centre of trade

indicators.note: displayed in centre of means the shortened sign sits in the middle of the trade word

parts.note: barter is trade by exchange of goods

indicators.note: mostly means the sign word loses its last letter

parts.note: an omen is a sign of things to come

explanation.surface: A sign of market change shown at the heart of commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: The instrument measures air pressure, whose shifts indicate a coming change in the weather.

clue.text: In which you may find gravy or salt

definitions.text: In which you may find gravy or salt

parts.words: In which you may find gravy or salt
parts.note: a gravy jug of this name holds gravy, and an old salt (sailor) is found on a vessel

explanation.surface: A question about what holds condiments at table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'salt' is not the condiment but a seasoned sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A gravy server is called by this name, and a sailor is aboard such a craft.

clue.text: Carry out final check for officer

definitions.meaning: in chess, to deliver checkmate ending the game
a merchant ship's deck officer below the captain

explanation.surface: An officer is told to do one last inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate is shortened to this word in chess, and a ship's first officer has the same title.

clue.text: Bulb lit repeatedly, consuming current

indicators.note: consuming means the doubled word swallows the next letter
repeatedly means the word for lit appears twice

parts.note: a light that is lit is on
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A light bulb flicks on again and again, using electricity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bulb' suggests a lamp, but it is the vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: This vegetable grows as a layered bulb, so it is a bulb in the botanical sense.

clue.text: See 6
Master in one section of school, briefly

parts.note: a means one
dept is the short form of department, a section of a school

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster working in one department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Master' looks like a teacher but is the adjective-noun for an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: An adept is an expert, someone who has mastered a skill.

clue.text: Crude line agent gets changed

indicators.note: gets changed means the letters of line agent are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rough secret agent gets transformed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something crude lacks refinement or grace, which is what inelegant means.
